Protecting European society from cyber threats
 NVISO brings together a team of cybersecurity professionals focused on doing things differently. Our mission is to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks by providing private and governmental organizations with services designed to prevent, detect, and respond to security incidents. Everything we do is guided by four core values: we are proud, we break barriers, we care, and we maintain a straightforward, no-nonsense approach.

 Proven experience managing complex technology or cybersecurity projects in client-facing environments.

 Clear communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

 A collaborative mindset that aligns with our core values of care and directness.

 Your benefits

jobs.title: Product Research Lead
jobs.description:
About Black Forest Labs 
 We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX — foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and videos. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.
 Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.
 
 Why This Role 
 Our model research moves fast. What's missing is someone accountable for one question: what should our models get better at next, and how will we know when they have?
 You’ll lead Product Research, the team between our researchers and the market. You’ll take raw signal from evals, leaderboards, customers and usage data, turn it into a clear measure of where our models stand, and decide which gaps matter most. Your squad of Applied Researchers runs the evals and closes those gaps through post-training. You’ll work closely with Research, Backend, Product and GTM.
 
 What You'll Work On 
 Evaluations. Own the product-facing eval taxonomy, eval strategy, and eval runs.

 Priorities. Maintain a ranked list of what our models should get better at, built from evals, leaderboards, customer feedback and usage data, and make sure it shapes every research cycle.

 Applied post-training. Set the priorities for the squad's Applied Researchers, who finetune and run RL to improve our core models and to build variants for specific customers and products. You decide what's worth building, define what success looks like, and check that results hold up with no regressions.

 Data. Define the data we need to measure and improve our models.

 Model releases. Co-lead new model releases. You own the quality go/no-go and the capability claims.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 PM experience (product or research) working directly on generative models. You've shaped the model itself rather than building features on top of it.

 Real technical depth. You can read an eval design and spot what's wrong with it, and you understand finetuning and RL well enough to scope and challenge the work. Researchers take you seriously because of what you know.

 Strong judgment on trade-offs made with incomplete signal, and the drive to own prioritization end to end.

 Comfort in an ambiguous, fast-changing research environment, where the right priority shifts as the model and harness evolve.

 You've done at least one of these:
 Defined what a generative model should get better at, and got a research team to act on it.

 Turned a messy backlog of model weaknesses into ranked priorities that survived contact with a research org. Sources might include bug reports, leaderboard gaps, and customer complaints.

 Owned evaluation for a model release, including the ship call or the capability claims.

 Scoped and shipped a finetuned model or variant for a specific customer or product need.

 Diagnosed a quality regression or plateau and traced it to a data, training, or eval-design cause.

 Nice to have: hands-on eval or ML engineering experience, and experience with diffusion or video models.
 
 How We Work Together 
 We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll join us in Freiburg at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.
 
 Everything we do is grounded in four values: 
 Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

 Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

 Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

 Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

 If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.
 
 Compensation : 172K-220K base + equity, depending on profile

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) | Festanstellung oder Freelance | München / Remote
jobs.description:
Standort: München, remote innerhalb Deutschlands
 Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft
 Warum diese Rolle 
 Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.
 Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.
 Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026 
 Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.
 Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?
 Aufgaben
 Was du machst 
 Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

 Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

 Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

 Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

 Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

 Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

 Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise 
 Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

 Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

 KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

 Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

 Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.
 Anforderungen
 Was wir suchen 
 Must-haves 
 Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

 Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

 Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert.

 Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

 Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

 Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

 Nice-to-haves 
 Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik.

 Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

 Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

 Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.
 Benefits
 So arbeiten wir 
 Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

 Flexibel: remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Standort München. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten.

 Wenig Bürokratie: klare Verantwortlichkeiten, schnelles Feedback, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

 Was wir bieten 
 Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, je nachdem, was besser zu dir passt.

 Eine Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung entspricht, als Gehalt oder als Tages- bzw. Stundensatz.

 Die langfristige Perspektive, unseren Produktkern zu verantworten.

 Viel Eigenverantwortung und unmittelbare Wirkung auf ein echtes Produkt, das von aktiven Unternehmen genutzt wird.

 So bewirbst du dich 
 Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht über dich, deinen Hintergrund und deine Verfügba

jobs.title: Marketing & Growth Project Manager - Meals
jobs.description:
En bref

Chez Picnic, nos clients sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. En tant que Meals Business Manager, tu seras le moteur de l'un de nos principaux leviers de croissance : les recettes. Avec un catalogue de plus de 1000 recettes et un planificateur de repas unique, notre ambition est claire : s'intégrer durablement dans le quotidien et les habitudes culinaires des Français.

Pour y parvenir, tu collaboreras avec des développeurs de recettes, des analystes et des créatifs pour faire rayonner notre fonctionnalité recettes sur tous les canaux : in-app, paid social, newsletters, et bien d'autres. Ta mission : transformer chaque interaction en une invitation à cuisiner avec Picnic.

Tes missions

  • Planifier et exécuter des campagnes 360° : Concevoir et piloter de A à Z des campagnes cross-canal ambitieuses (comme notre campagne de Noël) pour offrir des expériences clients cohérentes, créatives et engageantes.
  • Gérer les communications quotidiennes : Créer, planifier et optimiser l'envoi de newsletters, notifications push et autres communications régulières pour informer nos clients, nourrir leur inspiration culinaire et générer du trafic sur l'app.
  • Valoriser nos fonctionnalités et notre assortiment : Mettre en avant les atouts de l'app Picnic et de notre offre produit avec créativité, pour inspirer et guider nos clients à chaque étape de leur parcours.
  • Piloter la performance par la donnée : Concevoir et mener des A/B tests, analyser les résultats et traduire les insights en actions concrètes pour améliorer en continu la performance de nos campagnes.
  • Contribuer à la croissance business : Identifier et mettre en place des actions ciblées et autonomes pour générer une demande supplémentaire et atteindre nos objectifs hebdomadaires.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Picnic : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Meals internationale et les créatrices de recettes en local, ainsi qu'avec les analystes et créatifs, pour co-construire des campagnes à fort impact.

À propos de toi

 

  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un Master en Marketing, Business, Communication ou domaine connexe.
  • Tu as entre 3 et 4 ans d’expérience à temps plein dans un rôle lié au growth marketing, à l’activation client ou à la gestion de campagnes digitales multicanales. Tu as déjà travaillé sur la promotion de fonctionnalités produit, de parcours in-app ou d’expériences digitales, avec une forte orientation acquisition et activation client.
  • Tu as évolué dans un environnement exigeant et hands-on : startup, scale-up ou organisation avec un fort niveau d’autonomie et de responsabilité. Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements rapides et opérationnels, où les décisions ont un impact visible immédiatement.
  • Tu as déjà piloté des campagnes ou projets créatifs impliquant de multiples stakeholders (Design, Copy, Business, Tech, agences, etc.) et sais faire avancer des sujets complexes jusqu’à une exécution irréprochable.
  • Tu combines créativité et esprit analytique, et sais naturellement transformer des insights en actions concrètes. Tu es à l’aise avec Excel et capable de prendre des décisions basées sur des données. 
  • Le français est ta langue maternelle et tu maîtrises parfaitement l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Tu as une forte affinité pour l'univers de l'alimentaire et le goût des bonnes choses. Tu aimes mettre en valeur de façon authentique les bons produits, les producteurs et le terroir.

 

Avantages Picnic

🍴 Restauration 

Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary 
 Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. 
 We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Product vision, grounded in real user needs 

 You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. 
 Market scoping and opportunity-spotting 

 Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. 
 Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

 Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. 
 The full lifecycle 

 From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. 
 The connective tissue across the company 

 When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. 
 
 The team you’ll join 
 You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. 
 
 Life at Bluerock 
 We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 
 
 
 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. 

 Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field required. 

 A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. 

 Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. 

 An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. 

 Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. 

 Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. 

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. 

 Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment 

 
 Our hiring process 
 Hit the Apply button. 

 Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview 

 A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. 

 An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. 

 
Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

It spans an unusually broad portfolio: curriculum-aligned virtual science labs; the evidence-based intervention products Calcularis (numeracy and dyscalculia), Grafari/Orthograph (literacy and dyslexia); and browser-based Software & IT and Coding labs for technical training. Shared capabilities include cloud-based hands-on environments with no installation, automated assessment and grading, group assignments and instructor assistance, LMS integration, and learner analytics and dashboards. 

The product is in production across three distinct markets. Higher education and research, schools and public education authorities, and corporate and vocational training. The platform operates under GDPR, FERPA, COPPA and SOPIPA commitments. 

About the Role

You will own Constructor Practice content portfolio of products (currently includes Practice: Science Labs and Practice: Schools Math and Literacy with future extension to other disciplines) end to end: strategy, roadmap, commercial performance and delivery. This is a lead product management position with full accountability for the product line rather than for a single feature area or squad. 

The scope is wider than a conventional PM role. You will sit in front of clients during presales, shape the go-to-market with sales and marketing, define the roadmap across a portfolio serving three different buyer types, and work with product owners and engineering to bring releases in on time and on budget. Where the product line needs something that has no owner, it is yours. 

Practice has an established customer base and a portfolio that has grown through acquisition and expansion into markets with little in common: a Swiss canton buying dyscalculia intervention for primary schools has almost nothing in common with Acronis training its partner ecosystem. Bringing coherence to that portfolio, deciding what to invest in, what to standardize and what to retire, is the central problem of this role. 

Reporting and scope 

  • Reports to: Head of SI and Edu, Constructor Labs. 
  • Level: Lead Product Manager. You will lead the product team including product owners, engineers and subject matter experts, with a view to building a larger product team as the line grows.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Als Senior Projectmanager (Program Manager) binnen het People & Process Office van CloudNation ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van complexe cloud- en AI-programma’s. Je zorgt voor voorspelbare uitvoering, sterke governance en meetbare bedrijfsresultaten. In nauwe samenwerking met de Customer Lead, die verantwoordelijk is voor klantstrategie en waardecreatie, draag jij de verantwoordelijkheid voor delivery, planning, risicomanagement en operationele excellentie over teams, projecten en platforms heen.
 Je stimuleert schaalbare dienstverlening, ondersteunt strategische initiatieven zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) en benut AI om programmamanagement en uitvoering verder te versterken.
 Succes wordt gemeten aan de hand van betrouwbare oplevering, effectief stakeholdermanagement, transparantie, risicobeheersing en continue verbetering binnen cloud- en AI-trajecten.
 Leid strategische cloud- en AI-programma’s en zorg voor succesvolle levering, sterke governance en aantoonbare bedrijfsresultaten.

 Vertaal klantdoelstellingen naar uitvoerbare plannen, roadmaps, budgetten en leveringsprioriteiten.

 Bouw en onderhoud vertrouwde relaties met klant stakeholders, waaronder senior management en directieleden.

 Stimuleer AI-gedreven delivery door Responsible AI, compliance, kwaliteit en operationele excellentie te integreren in de uitvoering.

 Werk nauw samen met Customer Leads om strategie, uitvoering en governance op elkaar af te stemmen.

 Signaleer groeikansen en stimuleer de adoptie van strategische proposities van CloudNation, zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

 Zorg voor heldere rapportages, effectief risicomanagement en continue verbetering binnen programma’s en teams.

 
 Gekoppeld aan het 6D Delivery Model 
 Discover 
Werk samen met Business Relationship Managers en klanten om doelstellingen, drijfveren en uitdagingen te begrijpen, inclusief de gebieden waar AI aantoonbare toegevoegde waarde kan creëren.
 Define 
Stel duidelijke programmadoelstellingen, scope, tijdlijnen en succescriteria vast, afgestemd op strategische prioriteiten en, voor AI-initiatieven, op data-volwassenheid en compliance-eisen.
 Design 
Begeleid teams bij het vormgeven van oplossingen met behulp van frameworks zoals Azure CAF & Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework, waarbij Responsible AI waar relevant wordt geïntegreerd.
 Develop 
Stuur op een hoogwaardige en flexibele uitvoering (Agile of Waterfall), inclusief beoordelingsmomenten en kwaliteitscontroles voor AI/ML-ontwikkeltrajecten.
 Deploy 
Leid de implementatie en overdracht van opgeleverde resultaten, waaronder CCoE-initiatieven en productiegereedheid (inclusief MLOps voor AI-oplossingen).
 Continuous Delivery 
Ondersteun klanten bij het operationaliseren van resultaten, draag samen met de Customer Lead verantwoordelijkheid voor governance en behoud het overzicht op continue verbetering en waardecreatie.
 
 
 
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het leiden van complexe cloudtrajecten, inclusief het aansturen van meerdere teams, budgetbeheer en stakeholdermanagement op senior niveau.

 Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe programma’s met meerdere teams, waaronder de implementatie van proposities zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

 Sterke ervaring met delivery management in multicloudomgevingen (Azure en AWS), inclusief Azure CAF / Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

 Ervaring met AI- en/of dataprogramma’s, inclusief Responsible AI, compliance (zoals de EU AI Act) en de MLOps-levenscyclus.

 Werkt aantoonbaar AI-ondersteund, bijvoorbeeld met AI-agents zoals Claude of Claude Code, en stimuleert deze werkwijze binnen teams.

 Sterk in verwachtingenmanagement en in staat structuur en rust te brengen in complexe, veranderende omgevingen.

 Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden tot en met C-level, met sterke beheersing van risico’s, afhankelijkheden en budgetten.

 Kan de administratieve aspecten van programmamanagement zelfstandig beheren, waaronder projectinrichting, planning en facturatie.

 Aufgaben
 Kundenfeedback und Anforderungen aufnehmen, hinterfragen und priorisieren
 eigene Produktideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge entwickeln
 Anforderungen klar und verständlich für unser Entwicklerteam formulieren
 fachliche Rückfragen während der Umsetzung klären

 gutes technisches Verständnis – du musst nicht programmieren können, solltest dich aber sicher mit Entwicklern über Anforderungen und Funktionen austauschen können

 klare Kommunikation mit Kunden, Partnern und Entwicklern
 eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Themen von allein weiterlaufen
 Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge bis zum Ergebnis zu treiben
 fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform - PDEGO
jobs.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Data to join our talented product team in our London office and lead the development of a portfolio of shared data products.

Our products and teams work with data spanning streaming, fan engagement, social and creator activity, and commerce. As new datasets and requirements emerge, we need to understand what the data contains, establish what it means and make it useful beyond the team or product where it originated.

You will own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of a portfolio of shared data products. Working with business stakeholders, source-product owners and data engineering, you will turn business needs into clear requirements, deliver dependable datasets and establish definitions and relationships that can be reused across products.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of shared data products, with a focus on developing new datasets to meet emerging business needs. Understand needs across teams, identify valuable opportunities and prioritise a portfolio of initiatives that supports artist teams and the wider business.
  • Turn business requests into well-defined data initiatives. Meet the people who produce and use the data, examine source datasets and establish the questions users need to answer, the information required and the measures of success.
  • Define reusable datasets with engineering. Agree on the records, fields, relationships, quality, freshness and access requirements needed for each use case you’re defining. Establish clear acceptance criteria and resolve tradeoffs with stakeholders and engineers.
  • Lead delivery and adoption. Maintain a prioritised backlog and work with engineering through implementation, validation, launch and ongoing improvement. Ensure the teams receiving the data can use it to meet the agreed need.
  • Steward shared definitions and data models. Work with domain experts and engineers to establish consistent definitions, identifiers, relationships and metrics. Develop the shared semantic layer through the initiatives you deliver, so concepts such as artists, tracks, markets, campaigns and audiences can be understood consistently across products.
  • Connect datasets to enable new capabilities. Identify where combining data creates value and lead the product work required, including opportunities to relate streaming performance to social activity, campaigns, fan engagement and commerce.
  • Make data discoverable and understandable. Ensure data products have clear documentation, usage examples and known limitations, helping analysts, data scientists and downstream product teams use them confidently.

jobs.description:
Company Overview 
 At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.
 
 The Role 
 As Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery, you will sit at the handoff point between ideas and engineering — taking a raw idea or ask and shaping it into a well-formed request the software team can build against. You own the what: defining the problem, scope, and acceptance criteria behind every request. Working alongside the Project Manager, who runs sprints and day-to-day delivery mechanics, you'll advocate for how requests should be sequenced and when they should land, making sure priority calls reflect the needs behind the work rather than just what's next in the queue.
 At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Turn ideas into formal requests: work with the Product Lead and other stakeholders to take a defined ask and translate it into a clear, engineering-ready ticket — problem statement, scope, acceptance criteria, and any relevant regulatory or clinical context — before it enters the backlog.

 Own and prioritise the software ticket pipeline in Jira: intake, triage, and grooming, so the backlog reflects real, current priority rather than the order things happened to arrive in.

 Own the idea-to-documentation handoff with the software team — making sure every piece of work that reaches engineering has the context, requirements, and supporting documentation it needs in Confluence, and that decisions made along the way are captured rather than lost in Slack.

 Advocate for how and when work should happen: partner with the Project Manager, who owns sprint planning and delivery mechanics, to make sure sequencing and timing reflect genuine priority rather than convenience.

 Keep the software pipeline's information in the right place — Jira for delivery, Confluence for documentation — rather than in slide decks or side channels, and help extend that operating model as the team grows.

 Skills & Experience: 
 Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Product Owner working directly with a software engineering team, ideally in a regulated or safety-conscious environment.

 Comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for engineers to build against without repeated back-and-forth.

 A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

 Comfortable in an early-stage environment where requests arrive informally and priorities shift, and where part of the job is imposing structure rather than just following it.

 Drawn to the operational side of product management — energised by getting the machinery of idea-to-delivery running smoothly, not just by defining the vision.

 Nice to have: experience in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software environment, with exposure to documentation practices under ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

 Nice to have: prior experience setting up or overhauling a ticket intake and triage process from scratch, rather than inheriting one.

 Nice to have: some exposure to embedded or real-time software, enough to sanity-check scope and complexity when shaping requests.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role

As the Staff Product Manager, UK Market, you will define and execute Motive's product strategy for the UK, with the opportunity to expand your scope to continental Europe over time. You will own the commercial roadmap: where we compete, what we build, and in what order. You will then deliver it, working with engineering teams and peers across the product organization.

International expansion is one of the most important strategic initiatives at Motive. You will partner closely with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, product leaders, designers, and engineers to bring our products to customers who face different regulations, vehicles, hardware, and buying needs than in the US. You will be a senior voice in the room as leadership decides where to invest, and you will see those decisions through to shipped product.

To succeed, you must be comfortable influencing leaders across the company and navigating complex technical and organizational challenges. We operate like a startup within a larger organization, so you will wear many hats. Being entrepreneurial, commercially minded, and growth-oriented is critical.

  • Define the UK product strategy. Decide which segments, products, and use cases to prioritise to win, grounded in customer, competitive, and regulatory insight.

  • Build a deep understanding of UK customers, from fleet operators to drivers, through regular customer visits and field research, and translate what you learn into clear product requirements.
  • Influence across the product organization so that shared platform and product teams deliver against UK priorities.

  • Contribute to the broader international strategy through market research, benchmarking, and financial and risk assessments.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in product management at a B2B company or on operational products, with a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives at scale.

  • Experience in a startup or new team environment.
  • Based in the UK. London preferred for in-office collaboration. Ability to travel within the UK for customer visits and field research (about 1-2 times per quarter) and to San Francisco 1-2 times per year for team meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with products similar to Motive's, such as connected devices, telematics, fleet or asset management, IoT hardware plus software, or AI video and safety products.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.
 Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.
 As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.
 Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.
 Additionally, you will:
 Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

 Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

 Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

 Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

 Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

 Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager

About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an  AI-first way of working . You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.

 Your Mission Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
 Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
 Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
 Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
 AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
 Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
 Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
 Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.
 

 Your Profile 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
 AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
 Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
 Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
 Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
 Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
 Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.

Chez Seyna, notre mission est simple: permettre aux professionnels de l'assurance de protéger ceux qui voient grand. 
 Rejoins notre mission ! 🚀 
 Seyna est un assureur qui apporte une efficacité incomparable aux courtiers. Grâce à sa technologie et à la réactivité de ses équipes, Seyna accompagne les courtiers à chaque étape de leur développement : création du produit d'assurance sur-mesure, outils de vente et de gestion, analyse et amélioration du produit d'assurance, conformité.
 Depuis son lancement en 2019, date à laquelle Seyna a obtenu son agrément ACPR d'assureur, Seyna a convaincu plus de 100 courtiers, dont SPVIE, Verspieren, WTW, Garantme, APRIL, Marsh ou encore Dalma. Ils utilisent Seyna pour protéger près de deux millions d'assurés dans 6 pays européens. Grâce à un investissement de 57 millions d'euros de la part de GFC, WhiteStar Capital, Elaia et 115K (La Banque Postale) Seyna a des ambitions mondiales pour améliorer le secteur de l'assurance en modernisant la conception et la gestion des programmes d'assurance.
 Aujourd'hui, nous n'avons pas de poste ouvert pour le rôle d'Insurance Project Manager, mais nous savons que les choses peuvent évoluer rapidement. En rejoignant notre Talent Pool, vous serez directement dans la boucle si une nouvelle opportunité se présente.

 Si vous croyez en notre mission et que le rôle vous parle, n'attendez plus : postulez ! Si une opportunité se présente, vous serez parmi les premiers à être contactés. 🙌
 
 Ta future équipe :

 Ce que tu feras :

 Tu es au bon endroit si : 
 Tu as d'excellentes compétences en gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur d'exécution, respect des jalons

jobs.title: Product Manager - CDI
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 
  
 Notre mission 
  
 Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. 
 ⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 
 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !
 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! 
  
 Le mot de la CEO 
 “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon
  
 Et ce poste alors ? 
  
 Le rôle 
 Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).
 Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres.
  
 Missions et responsabilités 
 Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.
 Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup , où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.
 Discovery continue 

 Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.
 Shaping & conception 

 Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.
 Delivery & impact 

 Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.
 Ownership & autonomie 

 Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.
 
  
 Tes objectifs: 
 ⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre 
 Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.
 Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.
 🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap. 
 ⭐ De 1 à 3 mois — Prendre en main ton périmètre 
 Tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit. Tu mèneras tes propres investigations, participeras au shaping des sujets, concevras les solutions avec l'équipe et suivras leur livraison.
 🎯 Objectif : mener de manière autonome un sujet produit, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à sa mise en production. 
 ⭐ De 3 à 12 mois — Devenir pleinement autonome 
 Tu pilotes ton périm

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico 
 Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
 We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 Pelico is seeking a Lead AI Product Manager to pioneer our agent-first product strategy in Paris. You'll define and build the next generation of autonomous AI agents that transform how aerospace and manufacturing companies plan, optimize, and execute complex supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI in enterprise B2B, creating intelligent systems that make decisions, take actions, and deliver measurable business value autonomously . 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own the product vision and execution for autonomous AI agents — define agent architectures, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform supply chain planning, inventory optimization, production scheduling, and MRO operations

 Lead complex cross-functional AI initiatives — drive discovery of high-value use cases, design agent personas and reasoning patterns, and pioneer agent-native UX paradigms including conversational interfaces and proactive recommendations

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, customer operations, sales, and enterprise customers to ensure AI features deliver measurable value and achieve adoption at scale

 Define the AI product vision and strategic roadmap with VP Product and engineering leadership, balancing innovation with enterprise deployment requirements around scalability, explainability, security, and compliance

 Drive excellence in AI product development — from experimentation frameworks to deployment best practices — championing data-driven decision making and rapid iteration to launch capabilities that deliver 10x productivity improvements to enterprise customers

 
 About You 
 5+ years in product management with 3+ years building AI/ML products, including hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, autonomous agents, or intelligent automation in Enterprise B2B SaaS

 Strong technical acumen across agent architectures — including multi-agent systems, LLM-based reasoning, tool use, RAG, RLHF, and safety mechanisms — to collaborate effectively with ML engineers and data scientists

 Proven track record shipping autonomous AI products to large enterprise customers, with experience navigating safety, compliance, auditability, and controlled autonomy requirements

 Outstanding communication skills in English and French — able to articulate complex agentic AI concepts to executives, engineers, and end users alike

 You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what’s possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

 Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

 Experience building agent-based products with frameworks like LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures

 Background in operations research, supply chain, manufacturing, or aerospace industries

 
 Why Pelico 
 We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:
 Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

 Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

 Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

 Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

 Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

 Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

 A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
 Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
 Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
 After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
 If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

 What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
 You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
 We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
 Own the wealth product area end to end 
 Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
 Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
 Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on 
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
 Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
 Own the numbers 
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
 Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
 Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
 

 What we are looking for You might be a fit if: 
 You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
 You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
 You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
 You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
 Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
 You're fluent in English; German is a plus
 You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
 That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 
 Strong plus if you have: 
 PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
 Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
 Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
 Subscription and paywall experime

jobs.title: Project Manager Supply Chain (m/w/d)

 Project Manager Supply Chain (m/w/d)  
 auf 40-Stunden-Basis.

Du sorgst dafür, dass Projektziele, Aufgaben, Verantwortlichkeiten und Timings klar definiert sind , behältst Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent verfolgt und umgesetzt werden. 
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Supply Chain-Team sowie internen Schnittstellen  wie Accounting, Controlling, Sales, IT und E-Commerce zusammen und koordinierst projektbezogen auch die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern sowie unseren Kollegen aus Europa und China. 
 Ziel der Rolle ist es, zusätzliche Projektkapazität innerhalb unserer Supply Chain zu schaffen, bereichsübergreifende Themen strukturiert voranzutreiben und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen. 
 *Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit haben wir auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung männlicher, weiblicher und diverser Sprachformen verzichtet und das generische Maskulinum genutzt.
Sämtliche Personenbezeichnungen gelten gleichermaßen für alle Geschlechter. 

 Deine Aufgaben Eigenständige Verantwortung für definierte Projekte im Bereich Supply Chain – von der Konkretisierung der Projektziele und Planung über die Umsetzung bis zur Implementierung und zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss.
 Selbstständige Strukturierung übernommener Themen: Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über die Ausgangssituation, identifizierst Handlungsbedarfe und leitest daraus eigenständig die erforderlichen Arbeitsschritte, Verantwortlichkeiten und Timings ab.
 Eigenständige Beschaffung und Zusammenführung notwendiger Informationen aus den beteiligten Fachbereichen, Systemen sowie von internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
 Koordination und Steuerung der beteiligten internen und externen Ansprechpartner sowie aktive Herbeiführung notwendiger Abstimmungen, Zuarbeiten und Entscheidungen
 Aktive Steuerung des Projektfortschritts: Du behältst Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick, hältst diese konsequent nach und greifst bei Verzögerungen frühzeitig ein.
 Frühzeitige Identifikation von Risiken und Hindernissen sowie eigenständige Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungsansätze und Maßnahmen bzw. gezielte Einbindung der erforderlichen Entscheidungsträger
 Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Abläufe im Rahmen deiner Projekte  sowie Erarbeitung und Umsetzung konkreter Optimierungen gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen
 Transparente Aufbereitung und Kommunikation von Projektständen, Ergebnissen und Entscheidungsbedarfe n gegenüber den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Verantwortliche
 Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen Implementierung und strukturierten Übergabe abgeschlossener Projekte in die operativen Prozesse und an die jeweils verantwortlichen Bereiche
 

 Dein Profil Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung / ein abgeschlossenes fachspezifisches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation .
 Du bringst Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, Supply Chain Management, in der Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld  mit.
 Du hast Erfahrung darin, Projekte mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Beteiligten zu strukturiere n, zu koordinieren und erfolgreich umzusetzen. 
 Du weist einen sicheren Umgang mit MS-Office-Programmen , insbesondere Excel und Outlook, auf; Erfahrung mit ERP- und Projektmanagement-Systemen ist von Vorteil.
 Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Du hast eine  strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und kannst komplexe Themen schnell erfassen und in konkrete Arbeitsschritte übersetzen.
 Du zählst die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Abhängigkeiten zu erkennen und mehrere Projekte strukturiert parallel zu steuern , zu deinen Stärken.
 Du arbeitest  eigenständig und verbindlich , hältst offene Punkte konsequent nach und sorgst dafür, dass aus Abstimmungen konkrete nächste Schritte entstehen.
 Du bist ein Teamplayer  in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und bringst Kommunikationsstärke sowie ein souveränes Auftreten im Umgang mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern mit.
 Du behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten und mehreren Beteiligten den Überblick über Ziele, Timings und offene Punkte. 
 Du begeisterst  dich für die Marke Bestway® und identifizierst dich mit unseren Produkten.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Project Manager Rolling Stock & Maintenance (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Als Senior Strategic Project Manager Rolling Stock & Maintenance (m/w/d) steuerst du strategisch wichtige Projekte rund um die FlixTrain-Flotte - von der Flottenentwicklung über Finanzierungsvorhaben bis hin zur Beschaffung neuer Fahrzeuge. Zusätzlich unterstützt du in allen übergreifenden Projekten im Bereich Rolling Stock und Maintenance. 

 Über die Rolle 

 

 
 Du leitest und steuerst strategische Projekte im Bereich Rolling Stock und Maintenance inklusive Priorisierung, Ressourcenplanung und Stakeholdermanagement - in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Rolling Stock, Maintenance, Finance, Legal und Operations 

 Refurbishment-Projekte bereitest du ganzheitlich für Entscheidungen auf und berücksichtigst dabei die Attraktivität des Produkts, kommerzielle Implikationen und den Nutzen für das Gesamtunternehmen 

 Zusätzliche Finanzierungsprojekte orchestrierst du aus Business-Sicht und koordinierst dabei interne Teams und externe Kapitalgeber 

 Marktangebote für neue Fahrzeugflotten bewertest du technisch und wirtschaftlich und führst bei geeigneten Optionen Verhandlungen bis zur Beschaffung 

 Zur Kapazitätssicherung und Flottenoptimierung sourcst und beschaffst du zusätzliche Lokomotiven 

 Die Performance der aktuellen Flotte überwachst und analysierst du kontinuierlich und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab 

 C-Level-Meetings bereitest du mit klar aufbereiteten Entscheidungsvorlagen und strategischen Analysen vor 

 
 

 Über Dich 

 

 
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Master, Diplom) in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 

 Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Unternehmensberatung oder im strategischen Projektmanagement bringst du mit 

 Erfahrung in der Bewertung und Beschaffung von Fahrzeugen oder technischen Assets, von der Marktanalyse bis zum Vertragsabschluss, zeichnet dich aus 

 Mit deinen ausgeprägten analytischen Fähigkeiten bereitest du komplexe technische und finanzielle Sachverhalte verständlich auf 

 Du trittst sicher auf C-Level-Ebene auf und überzeugst mit starken Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten 

 Unternehmerisches Denken und hohe Eigeninitiative helfen dir, in einem dynamischen Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen 

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1-Niveau) 

 
 

 Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

 Was Wir Bieten 

 
 Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. 

 Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. 

 Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. 

 Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. 

 Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. 

 Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. 

 
 
 Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

 Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

 Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

jobs.title: Product Manager (English/French)
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally

About the role

This role sits on the front line: you engage directly with enterprise clients, lead discovery to uncover core business challenges, and design and ship tailored AI solutions built on Unframe's platform. You own the work end-to-end, serving as the strategic and technical bridge from initial conversation through to final deployment.

This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.

What you’ll do

This is a project-led role with unmediated access to clients at every stage. You will typically manage several engagements simultaneously, with short planning horizons and evolving requirements. Roughly 30 to 40 percent of the role is active client management, ensuring senior stakeholders remain aligned through delivery, progress reviews, and post-deployment rollouts.

    • Lead Enterprise Discovery: Conduct discovery sessions directly with enterprise clients to map workflows, uncover business challenges, and distinguish surface-level requests from fundamental operational needs.
    • Design & Spec AI Solutions: Translate customer problems into structured solution plans on Unframe's platform. Write detailed specs and define prompt and context structures, owning the complete solution design.
    • Drive End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate with engineers and AI specialists to deliver solutions on target. Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.
    • Represent the User & Platform: Act as the voice of enterprise operators and domain experts while collaborating with the Platform team to identify reusable product patterns.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles, with a proven track record working alongside engineering teams on complex, fast-paced technical products.
  • Bilingual Fluency (English & French): Fluent in French to connect with users and stakeholders in France, and fluent in English for daily collaboration across our international teams.
  • Customer-Led Discovery: Proven experience personally leading consultative conversations with enterprise buyers and operators - not supporting a sales call, not interviewing platform users, but owning the conversation to surface unstated needs and translate them into clear solution scope.
  • Enterprise Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage senior client relationships through a complex delivery; keeping stakeholders aligned, navigating competing priorities, and being the primary point of contact when requirements shift or timelines compress.
  • Problem-to-Solution Design: Ability to start from a raw business problem without existing features for reference, defining exactly how an AI solution should function and writing precise specs for build teams.
  • Complex Delivery Execution: Experience shipping AI-powered features under tight timelines, managing evolving requirements, and documenting strategic tradeoffs.
  • AI Solutions Experience: Direct exposure to building with LLMs - writing prompt structures, defining context and output constraints, working with agentic systems, or managing model uncertainty in a shipped product or working prototype. This is the dimension most learnable on the job; concrete work product carries more weight than certification.
  • Builder Orientation: Driven by creating customer-facing solutions rather than simply managing traditional roadmaps or processing requests.
  • Core Competencies: Strong written communication, systems thinking, high attention to detail, fluent English (written and verbal), and the ability to navigate multi-faceted projects.

Location

Remote (France): This position is 100%

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

 Innovate with Tether

 Why Join Us?

 About the job 
 QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.
 As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.
 What You’ll Do 
 · Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery
 · Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early
 · Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed
 · Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status
 · Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned
 · Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones
 · Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems
 · Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 
 We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 
 This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 
 You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 
 If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 
What you'll do: Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
 Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
 Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
 Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
 Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
 Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
 Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
 Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
 Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
 
What you'll bring: Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
 Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
 Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
 The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
 The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
 Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
 Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
 Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
 Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
 Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
 An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
 You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

 All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 
 A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
 A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
 Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
 A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
 Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ
