jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us: 
 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
 Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
 At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the role: 
 We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.
 This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.
 We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . 
 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

 Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

 Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

 Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

 Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

 Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

 Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

 Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

 Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

 Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

 Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

 
 You're a great fit if you: 
 Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

 Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

 Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

 Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

 Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

 Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

 Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways —

jobs.title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.description:
About us 
 Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.
 As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.
 About the role 
 Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.
 As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

 Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

 Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

 Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

 Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

 Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

 Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

 Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

 Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

 Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

 About you 
 6+ years in product management

 Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

 AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

 Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

 Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

 Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

 Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

 Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

 You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

 Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

 A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

 Nice to have 
 Document or file-processing products

 A utility business with a strong free tier

 Experience with high-volume consumer tools

 Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

 Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate. 
 
 Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact! 
 Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.
 Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values .
 
 Our Benefits 
 🌍 You get to impact

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do
 Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

 Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

 Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

 Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

 Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

 Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

 Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

jobs.title: Copy of Product Manager, New Content Initiatives and Analysis
jobs.description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating or licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured content into the AlphaSense platform. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product and content management, collection operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the Content teams and with external partners and internal stakeholders.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a Product Manager for New Content Evaluation and Analysis to help us expand and strengthen the breadth, quality, and value of the data and content that power our Platform. Candidates should have deep knowledge of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of evaluating and integrating financial research content and AI-powered investment analysis workflows.

Major Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Identify the Need and Showcase the Value:  Help identify and evaluate third-party quantitative and qualitative datasets and content for the needs of the AlphaSense platform (e.g. market data, fundamentals, estimates, ESG, news, research, transcripts, regulatory filings, and alternative data). Work alongside Partnership Management and Content Leads to assess data quality, methodology, licensing terms, and integration feasibility.
  • Lead the Due Diligence Effort: Run point on active vendor evaluations, including data trials, support proofs of concept, and own the framework to evaluate coverage, timeliness, accuracy, and history analysis. Help build content org-wide business case for new datasets and quantify value proposition, cost, buy vs build impact, and strategic fit
  • Become a Use Case Expert for AlphaSense content. Contribute to market research and competitive analysis to identify net new opportunities for innovation and differentiation. Identify new high impact AI-driven functionality and data sets and formulate the licensing target vendor or self-sourcing strategy to introduce new content into the AlphaSense platform and agentic workflows.
  • Market Research and Assessment: Track industry trends and competing platforms, solutions, and content to deliver competitive intelligence and better evolve product and content vision. Keep abreast of a rapidly evolving competitive landscape and client expectations along with unprecedented LLM and AI workflow advances. 

Who You Are:

  • You have genuine excitement and passion for corporate finance, capital markets, and investment research coupled with data management expertise demonstrated either in previous capacity at a buy-side or sell-side firm or you have successfully supported AI products/features/data used by investment and data analysis professionals
  • You have natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and investment research and track record of expert-level data analysis at scale using traditional data query or generative AI tools and platforms
  • You have the energy and enthusiasm to work in a high-paced, high-growth environment and you are comfortable accommodating rapidly changing business priorities
  • You have excellent presentation skills with demonstrated ability to inform and influence executives and align with multiple levels of stakeholders
  • You have driven successful due dilig

jobs.title: Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell 

As a Product Manager at Picnic, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation, tackling complex challenges with fresh, groundbreaking solutions. This role is all about driving impact - you’ll develop product strategies by analyzing data and identifying opportunities that push boundaries and define the way we’re building our supply chain logic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Setting new standards: implementing the next generation of purchasing algorithms, last mile logic, warehouse components or onboarding automation
  • Improving the fully automated warehouse: going beyond the business case by designing better strategies and building robust systems (e.g. designing new picking strategies, improving the automated storage system)
  • Innovating across borders: building a new fully automated warehouse in Germany, opening a new warehouse in France or working on a streamlined supply chain across borders? You will deliver impact all over Europe.
  • Building sustainable solutions: launch new initiatives to improve the quality of fresh products like fruits, vegetables and bread during storage and delivery to improve customer satisfaction, and enable us to operate a supply chain where we consider safety first 
  • Leading with ambition: Using your relentless determination and grit to take the driver's seat and redefine the puzzle behind a smooth grocery shopping experience

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in a product-led company, ideally experienced with building supply chain solutions
  • Problem-solving mindset and passion for tackling complex challenges
  • Strong communication skills which allow you to convert abstract plans into concrete actions for your team

*Please Note: This is not a one-time hire. We’re hiring for this role throughout the year as part of our ongoing growth and expansion. 

Picnic Perks 

🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

🚲Health insurance discount & bike plan

We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application. 

🍎Learning & development 

You’ll get ample opportunity to work on yourself at Picnic. We offer personal development through Lepaya courses, Academy trainings, and more. Interested in improving your mental wellbeing? Through OpenUp you get free access to trained psychologists and many courses. 

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well.

jobs.title: Graduate Product Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Always wanted to build the systems behind one of Europe's most advanced supply chains? As part of this Graduate Program, you'll own part of Picnic's supply chain tech products from day one. You'll be end-to-end responsible for developing products that power our operations by understanding operational challenges, analyzing data, working with business teams, designing solutions with engineers, and validating impact through experiments and analytics. You're the one making it happen. The program at Picnic is one of the most ambitious tracks in the industry: from recent graduate to Product Manager.

Wondering what problems you’ll work on? Think optimising how items are picked in our automated fulfilment center, decreasing waste by optimal ordering, designing a flow how we make sure coolpacks for chilled deliveries get back to the fulfilment center or integrating with robots to automate our operations even more.

What you'll be doing

Over 18 months you'll learn everything it takes to build a great product by actually doing it. You'll work alongside experienced product managers in our team. You will spend your program embedded deeply in one supply chain domain to see the long-term impact of your products, with options to expand scope into adjacent domains as you scale after 18 months. Every 3 months, you will reflect on your growth and define new learning goals with your mentor to grow you into the Product Manager role as fast as possible. 

  • 0-6 months

You learn how to solve operational and internal user problems. From day one, you’ll help build features used by thousands of users, while getting to know our product end to end. To understand what to build, you’ll analyze operational processes through data analysis and interviews. Based on your learnings you’ll help shape new features.

  • 6-12 months

You build your first features from scratch. This is the first time you'll own the full product development lifecycle. With the help of an experienced Product Manager, you’ll scope a supply chain problem, shape the solution across design, engineering, data, and business. You’ll drive execution on your plan, ship to customers & see the direct impact of your work.

  • 12+ months

You own a product scope end to end. You decide what problems to solve and own the solutions: the research, the analyses, the designs, the stakeholders, the tech. You are in the lead and responsible for the outcome.

The Program

  • The launchpad to Product Manager. Learn everything there is about building product & become a PM twice as fast as the industry standard.
  • Ownership from day one. You’ll immediately work on improving our Supply Chain, alongside our experienced product teams. You’ll get to experience different scopes ranging from warehouse operations to ordering inbound and from optimal planning of deliveries and routing to our in-house built apps used by thousands of our operational colleagues. 
  • Tangible impact: Every feature you ship is measured, so you'll see the exact impact of your decisions in real data. If it works, double down. If it doesn't, own it and iterate.
  • Mentorship: You'll have a dedicated mentor accelerating your growth. Your mentor will grow you as a Product Manager, and also be your guide into the domain. But most of what you learn, you learn by actually doing it.

Who are you

We’re looking for future leaders who are hungry to learn, eager to build, and passionate about our mission. You don’t need years of product management experience, but you do need to show us you have the raw talent and drive to succeed.

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field like Econometrics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar. Recent graduate or up to two years of professional experience.
  • Builder at heart. You've taken initiative and created something from scratch, whether that's a side project, a new idea, or your own startup.
  • Highly ambitious, natural curiosity and empathy for users. You want to understand, you're always asking "why", and you always think about how to make things better.
  • Go-getter personality. You're biased toward action and constantly pushing toward clarity and delivery.

jobs.description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick. 
 

 About us 
 

 Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 
 

 Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 
 

 We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on. 
 

 Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself . We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves . 
 

 From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM. 
 

 Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading. 
 

 

 
 This role calls for a strong hunter mindset and passion for working in a hyper-growth MarTech scale-up with a rapid sales cycle. Good news: our differentiated product is already in high demand! We have a world-class sales organization with a strong pipeline bombarded with inbound marketing leads and SDR lead generation. We’ve got clients from every vertical imaginable, and our client base speaks for itself. So, you will be lucky to have a category leader product, fuelled by lightning-fast growth and our all-star engineers, and just as our co-founder/CRO promises, “If you stay humble and hungry, you’ll build a legacy here.” 

 

 If you are interested in further developing your sales career in SaaS, get ready to engage with enterprise-level clients in the UK market across various industries such as retail, finance, automotive, telecom, and travel through our product of client choice. (Actually, let’s make our clients do the talking — you can check their testimonials on our website !) 

 What You Will Do 
 

 You will handle overall responsibility for managing sales, achieving growth, and hitting/exceeding annual sales targets.

 You will interact with clients at all the stages of the sales cycle, from prospecting and acquiring clients through demoing the platform to negotiating and closing.

 You will provide on-the-ground support/mentorship for the Sales Development Representative (SDR) team to generate new qualified opportunities and pipelines through innovative outbound strategies.

 We create value by sharing thoughtful insights for our partners and potential partners. You will effectively communicate the value proposition through proposals and presentations. You also need to ensure that they get the most out of the deals we offer, such as free trials.

 You will be the guru of your own market and provide insight to the team on market trends, unmet needs, and opportunities to deliver greater value to clients by extending company offerings.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer - Audiobooks
jobs.description:
We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented Senior Product Manager to join the Books Vertical and lead end-to-end book experiences on Spotify: from discovery and conversion through to listening, and from the creator pipeline through to the consumer shelf. This role is about connecting the dots across our core experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling to make books work seamlessly on Spotify.

 Books are a major focus for Spotify, and we need someone who can look holistically across the book ecosystem to identify gaps, reduce friction, and make sure our experiences are coherent end-to-end. You'll focus on making the full books journey work better for listeners, creators, and rights-holders, not just shipping new features. You'll partner closely with Personalization, Subscriptions, Experience, and creator-facing teams to strengthen and evolve book experiences across surfaces, and help shape a product strategy that directly improves how listeners discover and enjoy books.

 What You'll Do 
 

 
 Shape and execute product strategy across core book experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling.

 
 Partner with teams across Spotify to identify and close gaps across book surfaces, creating a coherent end-to-end experience from content pipeline through to the consumer experience.

 
 Collaborate with Design, Engineering, Product Insights, and Program Management to lead improvements across discovery, conversion, listening, and creator-facing surfaces.

 
 Conduct, commission, and use research to understand listener behavior, creator needs, book consumption patterns, and market trends.

 
 Use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify the most impactful opportunities across the book ecosystem and prioritize accordingly.

 
 Define and track success metrics across the book experience, connecting upstream pipeline health with downstream listener outcomes.

 
 Identify systemic friction points and opportunities across the book ecosystem, and advocate for improvements that strengthen the end-to-end experience.

 Who You Are 
 

 
 You have 4+ years of experience in product management, ideally working across complex product ecosystems with multiple surfaces, partners, and dependencies.

 
 You have a track record of improving multi-surface product experiences, not just launching new features but making existing systems work better together.

 
 You use analytics, A/B testing, and user research to guide product decisions.

 
 You're comfortable working across both consumer-facing and platform or tooling surfaces, and can move between listener needs and creator needs.

 
 You communicate clearly and build shared understanding across teams that don't always see each other's work, translating between consumer, pipeline, and creator perspectives.

 
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and managing complexity across multiple teams and partners.

 
 You think in systems and map how changes in one part of the ecosystem (content pipeline, creator tooling, conversion flows, consumer surfaces) affect the rest.

 
 You look for the most impactful fix rather than optimizing surfaces in isolation.

 Where You'll Be 
 
 

 This role is based in London or Stockholm

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. 

 

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Monetisation)
jobs.description:
Poki is a fast-growing tech scale-up on a mission to build the ultimate online playground for casual web games. We have over 100 million monthly players and a thriving community of 500+ game developer teams. We believe sustainable advertising is the best way to keep high-quality games free and accessible across devices. As our Senior Product Manager for Monetisation & Adtech, you'll define how advertising works on Poki for players, developers and advertisers.

 What this job is about 
 You'll own the product strategy for advertising and in-game monetisation on the Poki platform. That includes improving revenue per player and per impression, and evolving our in-game ad formats and integrations. It also means improving our SDK and ad stack, and shaping how advertisers interact with our supply. You'll collaborate across engineering, developer relations, data and business teams. Together you'll ship improvements that help developers earn money, advertisers reach relevant audiences, and players enjoy a great free-to-play experience.
 Your work will directly affect 100 million monthly players, 500+ developers and global advertisers. You'll own a critical revenue pillar for the company and build deep knowledge of multi-sided platform dynamics and adtech economics. You'll join a diverse, talented and self-motivated team where autonomy is real, bureaucracy is minimal and experimentation never stops. There's no formal hierarchy, and you'll have a high degree of personal responsibility and freedom.

 Your Challenge 
 A roadmap you own end to end. You'll own the adtech and monetisation roadmap, from opportunity discovery and experimentation to rollout.

 Ad integrations that work for everyone. You'll evaluate and improve in-game and display/video ad integrations to optimise revenue, user experience and advertiser win rates. Every change touches players, developers and advertisers at once, and you'll balance the needs of all three.

 Better results with developers. You'll collaborate with game developers worldwide to improve SDK adoption and in-game monetisation performance.

 A clear view of the adtech landscape. You'll research how adtech is evolving to find opportunities and advantages for brands and advertisers.

 Poki's long-term monetisation strategy. You'll contribute to Poki's long-term monetisation strategy, business model and platform economics. That includes building buy-in for a vision that goes beyond optimising today's methods and unlocks new revenue streams.

 You 
 Have 6+ years of Product Management experience, including 2–3 years in online advertising, programmatic or monetisation. For example, Google Ad Manager, header bidding, SSPs or Prebid.

 Are technically literate. You can explain monetisation concepts to engineers and understand integration constraints.

 Are highly analytical. You're comfortable with experimentation, metrics and data-driven prioritisation.

 Are motivated by revenue outcomes. You care about improving developer earnings and platform economics.

 Are an effective stakeholder operator. You align engineering, data and commercial teams to ship meaningful improvements.

 Think strategically while working in an agile, iterative way. You validate ideas early.

 Bonus experience 
 Familiarity with gaming ecosystems or game design

 Experience with in-game ad UX or playable ad formats

 SQL proficiency

 Benefits 
 We believe great work comes from feeling supported, trusted, and able to grow. Alongside meaningful professional development in the position mentioned above, we offer:
 A competitive salary, with annual performance reviews.

 Flexible working hours and a culture that genuinely supports a healthy work–life balance.

 €2,000 annual Learning & Development Budget for courses, training, and learning.

 Travel cost reimbursement for employees living outside of Amsterdam.

 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus additional discretionary days.

 Hybrid work policy, with time split between home and our office, and the option to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

 State-of-the-art equipment, plus a €2,000 work-from-home budget.

 Free breakfast, daily catered lunch, and fresh coffee and drinks in our pet-friendly office at Spui, in the heart of Amsterdam!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Poki is on a mission to create the ultimate online playground, bringing easy access to the best games on web to over 100 million monthly players worldwide. These games are created by a dynamic global community of 500+ game developer teams. At the core of our work lies a simple belief: play is how we learn. This Senior Product Manager role is about taking a new extension of the Poki user experience from a blank page to market, with proven early traction.

 What this job is about 
 You'll own a new extension of the Poki user experience end to end, from market and audience research and pricing to product vision, roadmap, launch and iteration. You'll have full product ownership, including scope and prioritisation decisions within the agreed strategy. You'll lead a dedicated design, engineering and business team to bring the product to market fast, running fast launch and iteration cycles and working with them daily to ship and review iterations. Your week will mix talking to players and partners, market and pricing research, running your own analyses, writing specs and strategy docs, and prototyping with AI tools. You'll work closely with product leadership, data, and our business and commercial teams, and keep leadership regularly updated on progress and learnings.
 You'll be building something new from a blank page, with the reach of over 100 million monthly players behind you and a dedicated team from day one. The product is designed to be fun and to delight players. You'll be highly autonomous in driving the product and highly collaborative with your dedicated team and stakeholders, working iteratively and sharing progress early. We're looking for someone curious and open-minded, pragmatic, optimistic about what can be built, and a team player. If the product succeeds, you'll own a new pillar of Poki and can grow into leading the product line and the team around it.

 Your Challenge as a Senior Product Manager 
 Validate the opportunity. You'll turn market, audience and pricing research into a clear product thesis and business case. Within your first 3 months, that means a validated product thesis and a research-backed pricing direction.

 Define success metrics and an agreed roadmap. You'll set success metrics up front and make prioritisation decisions based on impact, with an agreed roadmap and success metrics in place by month 3.

 Find traction. You'll iterate from early signals to a product with proven adoption and a roadmap leadership buys into. At 12 months, success means early traction against agreed targets.

 Decide fast with incomplete data. The work comes with high ambiguity and few existing answers, so you'll need to make decisions before the data is complete and set your own metrics.

 Keep a new team focused. You'll keep your dedicated team focused while the product finds its shape.

 You 
 Have 6+ years of Product Management experience on web-scale consumer products used by millions. You understand consumer behaviour and scale at Poki's level.

 Have taken at least one product from 0 to 1, and launched and managed at least one mobile app. Taking a product to market is the core of this role, and mobile is needed for the new product's reach.

 Run your own analyses at an advanced level. You pull data, build models and draw conclusions independently, because a new product has no analyst queue to lean on.

 Are an advanced, hands-on user of AI tooling. You use it daily to research, prototype and analyse, because it's how a small team ships fast.

 Have proven experience in pricing and market research. You've designed research that answered a real business question, which matters because this product needs a validated audience and price point.

 Are an excellent, structured communicator. You create buy-in on a vision that doesn't exist yet, in writing and in the room.

 Have a strong sense of urgency and design for impact. You bias to action and validate early, because speed to learning decides whether 0 to 1 works. You set metrics up front and prioritise by expected impact rather than output.

 Bonus experience 
 Experience with consumer subscriptions, in-app purchases or other direct monetisation models

 SQL proficiency

 Familiarity with gaming or game design

 We believe great work comes from feeling supported, trusted, and able to grow. Alongside meaningful professional development in the position mentioned above, we offer:

jobs.title: Product Manager Operations
jobs.description:
Zit het in je aard om te ontrafelen hoe een proces nóg efficiënter kan? Als Product Manager Operations ben je de drijvende kracht achter de uitvoering van procesverbeteringen in onze operatie. Je duikt diep in de data, spoort knelpunten op en ondersteunt de Product Manager Operations bij het vertalen en opleveren van concrete oplossingen samen met ons development team.
 
 Wat je gaat doen
 Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, prioriteren en realiseren van aanpassingen aan onze operations tooling. Dit doe je om de groei van Crisp op een slimme en efficiënte manier te faciliteren.
 Je werkt samen met onze Lead Product Manager Operations, Analytics en de operationele teams om groeikansen en verbeteringen in hun werkprocessen te identificeren.

 Je gebruikt data uit de operatie om de impact van deze procesverbeteringen in te schatten.

 Je trekt je veiligheidsschoenen aan om input op de halen op de werkvloer.

 Samen met de developers bespreek je in welke technische aanpassingen aan onze tooling benodigd zijn om een procesverbetering te realiseren.

 Tijdens de implementatie van een verbetering zorg jij voor de borging van het proces.

 Zodra je een verbetering hebt doorgevoerd meet je de effecten. Je gebruikt deze data weer als input om een volgende verbetering te verkennen.

 Dit ben jij
 Als ideale kandidaat heb je enige ervaring opgedaan binnen het Product Management vakgebied. Je kunt goed taken prioriteren, en een inhoudelijk sterke sparringpartner voor zowel developers als managers van de verschillende teams. Daarnaast ben je gedreven om snel te leren en ontwikkelen. Je herkent je in het volgende profiel:
 Minimaal 1 jaar werkervaring als Product Owner of Business Analyst. Bij voorkeur in een scale-up omgeving.

 Afgeronde WO-studie in een technische, (bedrijfs)economische, of beta-richting.

 Bij voorkeur heb je ook: 
 Je bent nieuwsgierig aangelegd en kan goed samenwerken in verschillende soorten teams.

 Je hebt affiniteit met procesoptimalisatie, het liefst van logistieke processen.

 Je trekt graag je werkschoenen aan om op de vloer mee te kijken in het proces.

 Basiskennis van software-ontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld om snel complexiteit van nieuwe features in te schatten.

 Aantoonbare ervaring met AI en SQL om zelfstandig operationele data te analyseren.

 Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands, Engels is een pre.

 Wat wij bieden
 Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

 Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

 Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

 Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

 Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

 Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

 Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

 Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

 En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

 Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

You’ll enable energy companies to predictably rely on the load shed of aggregated smart devices, such as smart thermostats, to ensure dispatch is scalable, resilient, and easy to use.

jobs.title: Project & Account Manager B2B
jobs.description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.
 
 We groeien hard. En naast individuele woningeigenaren werken we ook steeds meer samen met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders die grotere aantallen woningen willen verduurzamen.
 
 Daarom zoeken we een B2B Account & Project Manager die deze projecten van begin tot eind in goede banen leidt. Iemand die overzicht houdt, afspraken nakomt en ervoor zorgt dat klanten, bewoners, installateurs en interne teams weten waar ze aan toe zijn.
 
 Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen onze zakelijke klanten en de mensen die de projecten uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat plannen niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook in de praktijk werken.
 
 Wat ga je doen? 
 
 Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grotere warmtepompprojecten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de installatie van warmtepompen in 50 woningen binnen één wijk, waarbij meerdere installatieteams, bewoners en externe partners betrokken zijn.
 
 Je zorgt dat projecten soepel verlopen 
 
 Je vertaalt afspraken met zakelijke klanten naar een concreet projectplan met duidelijke deadlines, verantwoordelijkheden en deliverables.

 Je bewaakt de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en afgesproken KPI's van projecten.

 Je werkt nauw samen met onze Installation Quality Specialist aan de voorbereiding en uitvoering van projecten. Jij houdt de regie over het totale project, terwijl de Installation Quality Specialist de technische kwaliteit bewaakt.

 Je stemt de voorbereiding en uitvoering af met onze interne teams, installateurs en externe partners.

 Je signaleert risico's en knelpunten vroegtijdig en zorgt dat ze worden opgelost voordat ze de voortgang in gevaar brengen.

 Je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten tegelijk en stelt prioriteiten waar nodig.
 

 Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze zakelijke klanten 
 
 Je onderhoudt relaties met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders.

 Je zorgt dat klanten weten wat ze kunnen verwachten, hoe projecten ervoor staan en welke beslissingen nodig zijn.

 Je organiseert de afstemming tussen alle betrokken partijen, van de opdrachtgever tot de bewoners en installatieteams.

 Je rapporteert over de voortgang, resultaten en kwaliteit van projecten en bespreekt verbeterpunten met klanten.

 Je bouwt aan langdurige klantrelaties door afspraken waar te maken en problemen goed op te lossen.
 

 Je helpt ons steeds slimmer te werken 
 
 Je kijkt kritisch naar hoe we grotere installatieprojecten organiseren en uitvoeren.

 Je gebruikt projectdata en KPI's om te begrijpen wat goed gaat en waar we kunnen verbeteren.

 Je helpt processen te ontwikkelen waarmee we steeds grotere aantallen woningen efficiënt en met hoge kwaliteit kunnen verduurzamen.
 

 Wat breng je mee? 
 
 We zoeken iemand die structuur kan aanbrengen in complexe projecten, maar ook pragmatisch is wanneer de werkelijkheid anders loopt dan gepland. Je kunt schakelen tussen een gesprek met een vastgoedmanager en het oplossen van een praktisch probleem met een installatieteam.
 
 Dit vinden we belangrijk: 
 
 Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met projectmanagement, waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijk was voor planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en resultaten.

 Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen, zowel intern als extern.

 Je weet hoe je meerdere projecten, deadlines en belangen tegelijkertijd managet zonder het overzicht te verliezen.

 Je bent gewend om met KPI's te werken en hierover helder te rapporteren.

 Je neemt eigenaarschap. Als iets niet volgens plan loopt, wacht je niet af maar kom je met een oplossing.

 Je bent organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en werkt graag in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

 Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je goed redden in het Engels.
 

 Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: 
 
 Ervaring met woningcorporaties, vastgoedbeheerders of andere zakelijke partijen in de vastgoedsector.

 Ervaring met de uitrol van grotere verduurzamings-, installatie- of renovatieprojecten.

 Affiniteit met warmtepompen, installatietechniek of de energietransitie.
 

 Je hoeft dus geen warmtepompexpert te zijn. Belangrijker is dat je weet hoe je een complex project succesvol organiseert, mensen meekrijgt en resultaten behaalt.
 
 Waarom DeWarmte? 
 
 Bij DeWarmte krijg je de kans om direct bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je werkt niet aan abstracte plannen, maar aan projecten die ervoor zorgen dat steeds meer woningen daadwerkelijk van het gas af kunnen.
 
 We zijn een groeiende scale-up met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en weinig bureaucratie. Je krijgt de ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, verbeteringen door te voeren en mee te bouwen aan hoe we onze B2B-projecte

 As a Sr. Project Manager at MustardSeed, you will be contributing to end-to-end project delivery within specified timeframes, budgets, and quality standards. As an experienced project manager already, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure the best possible outcomes, steering multidisciplinary teams towards common goals. 

The Sr. Project Manager is the chief “make sure it happens – and happens right” person on the project and has the overall responsibility for ensuring that the outputs from each project phase – the initiation, planning, execution and closing phases – are delivered according to the requirements established and approved for that phase, and that these outputs are consistent across all phases.

 This is a remote position – supporting customers virtually with rare travel to customer sites.

If you are highly skilled and enjoy challenging, important work while retaining the flexibility your life needs, we would like to talk to you!

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 
 We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.
 We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 
 This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.
 The Role 
 RevenueCat helps apps of all shapes and sizes make more money across mobile, the web, and a growing list of other platforms like Roku, Amazon, and even AR through support for Vision Pro. As a result, many different types of users log in and use RevenueCat on a day-to-day basis. Product managers, support reps, lifecycle marketers, user acquisition specialists, data analysts, executives: the list goes on.
 Communicating the growing breadth of use cases supported by RevenueCat in a way that makes sense for all those different types of businesses, apps, and users is a challenge. And that’s where product marketing comes in.
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team led by Francie . Each Senior PMM owns a product area end-to-end, partnering with that area's product managers on positioning, messaging, and go-to-market. This is not a segment-specific role: RevenueCat serves everyone from solo indie developers to top-tier enterprise apps, often through the very same product surface, so you'll craft messaging and channels that flex across that full spectrum. This role is perfect for someone who:
 Knows APIs and SDKs like their ABCs. Code may not be your craft, but you know how to talk the talk. Software developers are one of our core audiences, and they can smell BS a mile away. You can debug marketing messaging so it resonates with technical audiences, and craft narratives around the 1’s and 0’s that still land with business stakeholders.

 Captains their own ship. You have a strong bias toward action and you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty on execution. Whether it’s juggling strategic and tactical work or navigating shifting priorities, you thrive on autonomy and love making things happen.

 Distills collaborative chaos. You’re comfortable raising your hand and getting what you need from a dynamic and technical organization. Whether it’s nudging engineers for product updates or rallying Sales for customer stories, you can navigate the chaos and advocate for what the GTM org needs.

 Gets excited about the unexpected. At RevenueCat we take shipping seriously, and are constantly adapting our product and strategies to meet the needs of developers. You see changes in direction and shifts in strategy as an opportunity to flex your creative muscles and learn on the fly.

 Is a little quirky. You love a whimsical side quest and you can see the soft side of software. We pride ourselves in keeping our community on their toes with unique swag, challenges and events. You can play as big a role as you’d like in helping to brainstorm and bring these quirky concepts to life.

 What You’ll Be Responsible For 
 GTM and adoption campaigns: Own key product areas to deeply understand the features we’re launching and the use cases and needs behind them. Craft compelling communication plans both within the organization, and to existing and prospective customers.

 Lifecycle campaign building: Working with our marketing operations team to execute insight-based lifecycle campaigns to drive adoption, retention and community.

 Web page design and optimization: Translate product messaging and customer understanding into visually compelling and highly converting web experiences with the help of our external web development agency. You’ll chart the vision for the story our website tells and the illustrations, animations and tools we create to convey it.

About Ryft 
  
 Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.
 We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.
  
 We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.
  
 About the Job 
 Are you a strategic thinker who loves the intersection of business, technology, and finance? We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Ryft, a high-growth fintech start-up, to help define and drive the next generation of our payments platform.
 In this pivotal role, you will act as the bridge between our Executive/Sales teams and our Software Engineering teams. You will be responsible for translating high-level business vision and commercial requirements into a concrete, executable product roadmap. You won't just be managing features; you'll be shaping the future of how marketplaces and merchants handle payments globally.
  
 This is a hybrid role based in central Manchester, with 2 days per week in the office. 
  
 Responsibilities 
 Strategic Roadmap Ownership: Work directly with the Exec and Sales teams to identify market opportunities and define the features that keep the Ryft Payments Platform at the cutting edge.

 Bridge Sales & Engineering: Translate complex commercial needs and customer feedback into clear, actionable technical requirements and user stories for our engineering squads.

 End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate closely with Software Engineering to ensure features are built to a high standard and delivered on time for Ryft customers.

 Stakeholder Management: Balance competing priorities between sales-led requests and long-term platform scalability, keeping all parties aligned and informed.

 Market & Regulatory Insight: Stay ahead of industry trends and regulatory changes (like PSD3) to ensure Ryft remains compliant and competitive.

 Product Success: Define and track key performance metrics to measure the impact of new features and inform future iterations.

  
 Experience & Skills Required 
 Fintech/Payments Background: Proven experience managing B2B or Fintech products, ideally with a deep understanding of the payment value chain (Gateways, Acquirers, etc.).

 Strategic Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate with both executive leadership and technical teams, translating "business-speak" into "dev-speak" and vice-versa.

 Prioritisation Excellence: A data-driven approach to prioritisation, with the ability to say "no" or "not now" to protect the platform's integrity.

 Technical Literacy: While you don't need to write code, you should be comfortable discussing system architecture and technical constraints with senior engineers.

 Agile Leadership: Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments using Agile methodologies to deliver complex products.

  
 Nice to Have 
 Marketplace Experience: Familiarity with automated merchant onboarding and marketplace settlement flows.

 Regulatory Knowledge: Experience navigating financial compliance and regulatory landscapes.

  
 Why Ryft? 
 At Ryft, we value a "founder's mindset." You will have a massive impact on our trajectory and the autonomy to own significant parts of our product strategy. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and want to build the future of fintech, we want to hear from you.
  
 Right to Work: Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

 I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings.  Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.
 WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

 Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Trips
jobs.description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Steven , Lead Product Manager at WeTravel
 I'm hiring a Staff PM to own Trips, the domain where every trip comes to life. Ten thousand travel businesses build, present, and sell their trips with WeTravel, from boutique agencies to student travel operators running hundreds of departures a year, which makes this both the surface their teams spend most of their working day in and the first thing their travelers ever see. You'll own it end to end: the trip page they sell with, and the content and AI engine that crafts it, and the content specialists who build our library, who will report to you.
 
 About WeTravel 
 Travel gives people new experiences and brings them together, sometimes in life-changing ways. That's especially the case for group travel and multi-day travel (think of a 7-day safari in the Serengeti, a 5-day scuba diving trip in the Galápagos, or a multi-week pilgrimage) where travelers get to really immerse themselves. Passionate travel organizers make this magic happen, and WeTravel is here to support them.
 
 Multi-day travel businesses use WeTravel as their end-to-end operating system : publishing trip offerings, generating and converting leads, processing payments around the world, paying suppliers and vendors. WeTravel helps them grow sales, save time, and save money, so they can focus on delivering incredible bucket-list experiences.
 
 
 WeTravel is a 400+ person company representing more than 50 countries. We combine global diversity with the agility and closeness of a much smaller team. More than 90 colleagues are based in our Amsterdam office in Rokin, including the entire Product Org and most of our Engineering team.
 
 You will have fun innovating fast with brilliant, low-ego colleagues. Our clients are also easy to reach, which helps us stay close to their needs and build with them.
 
 Financially, WeTravel is highly secure and growing fast, with 50 to 100 percent year-over-year growth depending on the metric. This gives us a strong foundation to build from.
 
 About the Role 
 This is the domain where our biggest bet is playing out. Building and selling a great multi-day trip is a lot of work: crafting a story worth booking, assembling the content that tells it, and presenting it all in a page a traveler trusts. Our goal is to cut that turnaround down so organizers get back to their client faster, convert more of them, and sell more trips. It also has to hold up as they grow, because a boutique agency selling bespoke trips and a student travel operator running hundreds of departures are building on the same tools. The way we get there is great technology in the hands of organizers and their teams. You will own that end to end, the experience and the engine behind it.

 What you'll work on 
 
 WeTravel Trips give organizers the tools to create proposals, detailed itineraries and a high-conversion booking experience, while giving them time back to grow and operate their business.
 We're now looking for a Staff PM to take this domain through its next phase of growth, and make WeTravel the best software for travel businesses to build, present and sell their trips.
 Our success in this domain will drive the growth of our organizers by expanding in several areas:
 An integrated building experience that helps organizers find the right content and craft the right trip for the right travelers.

 Shared libraries that pay off most when a team works from them, so every proposal that leaves the company is consistent, beautiful, and unmistakably theirs, whoever wrote it.

 AI-enabled tools to imagine and create new trips, produce world class content, and optimize their sales funnel.

 Trip pages organizers can publish and promote wherever their travelers are.

 1/ Designing the trip page and selling the trip 
 Think of the trip page as the product detail page of the travel industry. It is where an organizer's work becomes something a traveler wants, understands, and buys.
 Dynamic Trip Builder: Intuitive tools for organizers to create their trip offerings, in the languages their travelers read, on WeTravel and beyond it.

 Day by day itineraries: the plan that makes a trip feel real before anyone has booked it, built fast and kept accurate as the trip changes.

 High converting pages and proposals: whether an organizer publishes a trip for the world or sends a tailored proposal to one client, the result has to look professional, capture travelers' imaginations, and turn interest into a booking.

 Mobile app for travelers: once they have booked, travelers carry the trip page in their pocket, with everything they need before and during it.

 2/ The content and AI engine that turns hours of work into minutes 
 WeTravel Library: a curated library of properties, activities, and reusable content on its way to 20,000 properties, so organizers build with high quality content.

 The organizer's own library: their photos, their descriptions, their reusable blocks, so a growing team sells in one

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

 AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

 A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

 Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

 Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

 

 Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

 Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

 Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

 Meet the team in the office. 

 Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

jobs.description:
Product Manager - Categories (f/m/d)

Location: Paris, France

Domain: E-Commerce Solutions — Navigate & Categories

ABOUT DECATHLON & THE E-COMMERCE DOMAIN

Decathlon is accelerating its digital transformation with the mission of becoming the sports digital platform that allows customers to discover our universe through local, sport-centered, and omnichannel experiences.

Our Mission: Bring people together through sport to make wellbeing accessible for all. 

By joining this scope, you will work within the E-Commerce Solutions domain. Our teams build and transform the global e-commerce navigation, catalog treeviews, and backend categorization engines aiming to allows users to effortlessly discover and access Decathlon’s complete offering of products, services, and information

 

JOIN THE CATEGORIES SQUAD

Reporting to the Group Product Manager (E-Commerce / Navigate), you will take ownership of the Categories squad. You will work alongside a dedicated engineering squad (Tech Lead, Senior Software Engineers), and collaborate closely with UX Researchers, Product Designers, Data Analysts, Sports Digital Merchandisers, and local Country E-Commerce teams).

Product Vision: Empowering discovery through intelligent, scalable navigation. We build an intuitive, automated, and personalized browsing journey so every customer finds what they need, want, and desire faster.

Drive global conversion and incremental revenue by transforming fragmented local treeviews into a unified, high-performing Core Navigation across web and mobile platforms.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Categories & Core Navigation ecosystem.
  • Own and arbitrate key product streams across Core Navigation (standardizing category trees globally) and SKU-Level Categorization Engines (such as our streaming engine Tesseract).
  • Align stakeholders across central sports teams, global digital merchandising, and local country teams around shared treeview operating models.

Discovery & Governance

  • Continuously identify user, SEO, and market opportunities through data analysis, user testing, and card-sorting studies.
  • Establish a continuous and consistent A/B testing process to refine business convictions and identify top growth opportunities
  • Balance global standardization with local market flexibility, ensuring smooth migration from local catalog treeviews to global Core Trees.
  • Establish clear decision-making frameworks and SLAs for global taxonomy, SEO content guidance, and category creation governance.

Delivery & Technical Alignment

  • Lead agile product delivery in close partnership with the Engineering Lead and squad members.
  • Prioritize and mature the team’s backlog (epics, user stories) to support multi-level export feed pipelines, batch orchestration tooling, and taxonomy rules execution.
  • Oversee key migration milestones for countries adopting the Core Navigation framework across desktop and mobile.

Data & Performance

  • Define and track success metrics across navigation channels, including PDP Reach Rate, Revenue per Session, Menu Usage CTR, and Category-Level Conversion.
  • Leverage data analytics to streamline category performance, eliminating inactive categories and optimizing taxonomy filters.
  • Arbitrate and prioritize backlog based on data driven decision 

Product Mindset & Culture

  • Serve as an ambassador for product excellence and taxonomy standards across Decathlon’s global network.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment based on trust, accountability, and user-centric decision-making.

PROFILE

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a fast-paced B2C e-commerce, digital platform, or catalog/search ecosystem.
  • Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of e-commerce navigation, catalog treeviews, taxonomy/metadata structures, or search & discovery platforms.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder international organizations (aligning global tech teams, business merchandisers, and country leads).
  • Product Methodology: Mastery of end-to-end product development
