jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

 This is a company built for growth, not comfort. 

 When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. 

 We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. 

 Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in. 

 If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. 

 What You’ll Own:

 
 Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.

 Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.

 Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.

 Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.

 Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.

 Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.

 Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

 
 What Success Looks Like:

 
 You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.

 Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.

 Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.

 Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.

 You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.

 You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

 
 What You Bring

 
 Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.

 Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.

 Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.

 Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.

 Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.

 Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deepl

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.
 Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.
 We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here .
 
 About the Role 
 
 As a Project Manager at Sona, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise implementations end to end, working alongside a Solutions Architect on each project. Assignments are based on capacity and fit rather than a fixed team, so you'll work across sectors, hospitality, retail and social care.
 
 You'll run implementations of Sona's products (HR, Scheduling, Payroll, LMS & ATS) end to end, ensuring delivery meets our scope commitments, budgets and timelines, all while providing an exceptional experience for our customers. You'll partner closely with senior stakeholders from our customers and internally across our Commercial, Product and Customer teams. We're a growing business, so you'll also need to thrive in a fast-evolving environment and be a strong advocate for clarity and communication.
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Lead and deliver projects on time, within scope and budget, maintaining the highest quality standards.

 Manage project risks, dependencies and scope, communicating mitigations and changes clearly to all stakeholders.

 Requirements

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with C-level executives.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.
  • Background at a data provider, enrichment vendor, market intelligence platform, or vertical search company, or experience building vertical data products in-house.
  • Experience evaluating and working with external data providers, including judging quality and negotiating what you actually need.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Toxic
jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Product Manager die Sdu Toxic laat groeien met proposities waar klanten aantoonbaar iets aan hebben.
 
 HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT 
 Sdu Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun gevaarlijke stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veiliger te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. Die expertise maakt het product sterk. Jouw opdracht is zorgen dat de markt dat ook ziet en ervoor kiest. Je krijgt de regie over een grote en diverse marktgroep met stevige commerciële ambities. Op basis van marktdata en klantinzichten bepaal je welke producten we ontwikkelen, wat erin zit, hoe we ze positioneren en via welke kanalen we ze in de markt zetten. Samen met de Pricing Specialist bepaal je de prijsstrategie. Je laat klanten valideren wat je bouwt en vertaalt hun feedback naar productontwikkeling en een commerciële aanpak. Bij grote en complexe klanten zie je kansen, en je bouwt strategische samenwerkingen op met klanten en partners zoals softwarebedrijven. Omzet, gebruik, verlengingen en klanttevredenheid houd je scherp in de gaten, en je stuurt bij waar dat nodig is. Innovaties die je voor Toxic ontwikkelt, kunnen breder binnen Lefebvre Sdu worden ingezet. Je bent sparringpartner van de Head of Innovation en coacht onze Product Marketeers in hun go-to-market aanpak. De kennis is er. Het product staat. Jij bepaalt hoe Toxic groeit.
 
 DIT ZOEKEN WIJ 
 Je combineert diepgaand marktinzicht met de daadkracht om iets nieuws op te bouwen, van klantvalidatie en positionering tot go-to-market en marktintroductie. Je krijgt mensen uit verschillende disciplines mee op inhoud en visie, en je pakt kansen op, ook als de aanpak nog niet vaststaat. Dit zoeken wij ook:
 Je hebt eerder verantwoordelijkheid gedragen voor producten, proposities of go-to-market in een complexe markt of klantgroep.

 Je hebt producten ontwikkeld én succesvol in de markt gezet.

 Je vertaalt marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar een heldere langetermijnvisie en concrete commerciële kansen.

 Je combineert commercieel inzicht met data en gebruikt resultaten om producten steeds scherper te maken.

 Je verbindt collega's uit product, IT, sales, marketing, content en customer support.

 Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

 
 HIER TEKEN JE VOOR 
 Je krijgt de regie over producten die bepalend zijn voor de groei van Sdu Toxic. Van markt- en klantinzicht tot positionering, prijs en go-to-market: jij brengt alles samen. Je hebt volop ruimte om innovaties Lefebvre Sdu-breed uit te bouwen, strategische partnerships aan te gaan en zichtbaar impact te maken op omzet, klantwaarde en groei. Vanaf dag 1 heb je invloed op hoe kennis wordt ingezet bij duizenden professionals in Nederland. Dit krijg je ook:
 Een salaris tussen €5.508 en €6.458 per maand, op basis van een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

 Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.

 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.

 Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

 Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.

 Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag.

 Als Senior Product Owner ben jij verantwoordelijk voor een domein binnen ons flagship: GenIA-L. Onze bestaande klanten stappen over naar het platform, en een klant die is overgezet maar het niet gebruikt, telt voor ons niet als resultaat. Jij zorgt dat onze klanten er echt mee gaan werken.  DIT ZOEKEN WIJ 
 Je voelt je thuis in een organisatie die middenin een transitie zit. Waar we vroeger een echte uitgever en drukkerij in hart en nieren waren, zijn we nu meer en meer een softwarebedrijf aan het worden. Daarnaast hou je ervan om te bouwen en kan je op strategisch niveau meedenken over de product visie en roadmap van Lefebvre Sdu.

Dagelijks werk je met front-end, back-end, DevOps, UX en AI engineering, elk met een eigen lead. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
INDG builds the systems behind large-scale visual content production. We turn physical products into digital twins, CGI content, interactive experiences, and automated product visuals for global brands that need quality, consistency, and scale. 
 
 As Senior Project Manager , you own the delivery rhythm for complex client programs where design, 3D production, development, review cycles, vendors, and brand requirements all meet. You are not just moving tasks across a board. You are structuring how work gets made, reviewed, approved, and shipped. 
 
 This role exists because INDG’s clients are asking for more than isolated CGI assets. They need repeatable production models: one source product model, many outputs, controlled visual quality, reliable timelines, and clear communication across teams. You will help build that operating layer. 
 
 You’ll manage projects in Consumer Products or Healthcare , where product accuracy, visual consistency, compliance, and delivery discipline matter. The outcome is clear: clients receive production-grade interactive experiences and 3D content that can scale across campaigns, platforms, markets, and product lines. 
 
 What You Will Do 
 Own complex delivery from kickoff to launch 
You’ll manage multiple interactive and CGI-driven projects at the same time, from scope definition through final delivery. You’ll translate client goals into timelines, resource plans, review flows, dependencies, and delivery milestones. You’ll know when a project is blocked by missing product data, unresolved art direction, technical debt, unclear feedback, or vendor capacity. 

 Connect clients, artists, developers, and vendors 
You’ll be the operating link between client teams, CG artists, designers, developers, producers, vendors, and agencies. You’ll make sure everyone understands what is being built, what quality bar applies, what decisions are pending, and what needs to happen next. You’ll keep communication specific, written, and actionable. 

 Build delivery systems, not one-off project plans 
You’ll improve how projects run. That can mean standardizing intake, tightening feedback loops, clarifying approval gates, improving Jira or project documentation, reducing manual handoffs, or creating better reporting for client and internal teams. You’ll look for repeatable patterns in CGI, digital twin, and interactive delivery and turn them into cleaner ways of working. 

 Protect visual quality while managing constraints 
You’ll understand that delivery is not complete because the file was exported. It is complete when the output meets the brief, the product is accurate, the interaction works, the render quality holds up, and the client can use it confidently. You’ll help teams balance scope, timing, budget, technical limitations, and visual ambition without hiding tradeoffs. 

 
 Who You Are 
 You think in systems, timelines, assets, dependencies, and visual outcomes. You can sit with a client discussing business goals, then work with a CG lead or developer to understand what is actually required to deliver the work. 
 
 You Have 
 3 to 5+ years of project management experience in a digital, production, CGI ( healthcare, consumer products) or interactive environment. 

 Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams across design, 3D, development, production, QA, vendors, and client-side reviewers. 

 Working knowledge of traditional project management and Agile methods. Scrum Master, Prince2, or similar certifications are useful, but your delivery judgment matters more than the certificate. 

 A structured approach to documentation, planning, risk tracking, meeting notes, decision logs, project boards, and client reporting. 

 Strong English communication skills, with the ability to make complex delivery situations clear without overloading people. 

 Bonus value: experience with CGI, 3D production, digital twins, DAM/PIM/CMS integrations, healthcare content, regulated content review, or enterprise brand systems. 

 
 Why Join INDG 
 INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content. 
 Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

 Discover opportunities, scope them, and give your squad a clear what and a why they believe.

 Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into clearly scoped initiatives that deliver concrete outcomes.

 Collaborate closely with other PMs, analysts, engineers, data scientists and leadership to align priorities and ensure group-level strategy is translated into impactful work.

 Be a hands-on PM: dive into data, read documentation, QA features, and debug with engineers when needed.

 Raise the bar on how your team develops product, not only on what it ships.

 You always strive for clarity and transparency -an excellent communicator that can effectively collaborate both with engineers and business stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

jobs.title: Product Manager (all genders) - Remote Germany
jobs.description:
About Linro 
 Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. 
 Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.
 We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.
 
 The role 
 You would be our first dedicated product manager, working closely with the founders and the engineering team. You decide what we build next and in which order, across the whole product, and you ground those decisions in regular conversations with customers, from the first discovery call to the roadmap review. Clear priorities are the heart of this role: with a small team, picking the few things that matter most is what moves the product forward.
 
 What you will do 
 Talk to customers and prospects yourself (CISOs, security and platform leads): run discovery calls, demo what exists, take the objections and turn feedback into a clear, ordered roadmap.

 Own priorities and the backlog: keep one ranked list across the whole product and the tools around it, decide what gets built next and what does not using explicit criteria (customer pain, pilot and revenue impact, compliance relevance, engineering cost), and re-rank it with the founders every cycle. Write the PRDs and decision memos engineers build from, and check what ships against what you promised.

 Translate what customers need into clear requirements for engineers, including how our guardrails should behave when the user is an AI coding agent: tool design, failure modes, and what an agent may change on its own.

 Own releases end to end: plan them with engineering, define what done means, write clear release notes and make sure customers understand what changed and why.

 Be the product voice in front of customers: join sales and buyer calls, present the roadmap and handle security and compliance questions (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI). Set success metrics and launch criteria.

 What we are looking for 
 5+ years as a product manager (or a founder or engineer who moved into product) on B2B infrastructure, security or developer products sold to enterprises.

 Technical fluency. You can read a Terraform plan, you have a solid grasp of databases and SQL, you understand APIs at least at a high level, and you hold your own with engineers on trade-offs.

 Hands-on customer discovery. Customer interviews and pilots you ran yourself, and a record of turning that into a few sharp bets instead of a long list.

 Prioritization and written clarity. A record of ranking competing demands with a small engineering team, using explicit criteria, and of explaining those trade-offs clearly to customers and founders. Specs and decision memos that stand on their own.

 You know the buyer: CISOs and platform leads. You are comfortable in front of customers and executives: you can run a discovery call, a demo or a roadmap session on your own and earn the room. You can map features to compliance frameworks at product level, not auditor level.

 You use AI tools daily for research, synthesis and prototyping, and have a point of view on designing for LLM agents as users.

 Policy-as-code (OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Cedar), or time at a CSPM, IaC or CI/CD vendor.

 Zero-to-one product work at an early-stage startup.

 
 How we work 
 We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write decisions down, and protect people's focus time. We use AI coding agents ourselves, so specs need to be precise enough for a person or an agent to build from.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
The essentials
 Team: Product & Engineering
 Start date: As soon as possible
 Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office
 Working language: English (German: a plus)
 Salary band: Shared before your first interview
 Your impact
 As Growth Product Manager at 7NXT Health Group, you drive subscriber growth across all our brands. You find the problems behind our key metrics, test your way to solutions, and make sure what we learn in one brand helps the others. Your focus spans the subscriber lifecycle — with the emphasis on its two ends: acquisition and retention.
 You work in close collaboration with Marketing to bring the right people in and find the right offers to keep them: a lot of testing on pricing, offers, landing pages and cancellation flows. This is a mid-level role with real ownership in a fast-moving environment.
 What you’ll drive
 You own the experimentation roadmap, from metric to hypothesis to shipped test and clear result

 You partner closely with Marketing and CRM on funnels, landing pages and campaigns, and own the testing of pricing and offers

 You share what works across the group, so a win in one brand becomes a test in another

 What defines you
 Must-have
 Experimentation and growth mindset. You turn a metric into customer problems and sharp hypotheses, run sound A/B tests, and build a roadmap around what will move the number.

 Data and customer insight. You do your own analysis, from funnels to test read-outs, and combine it with research and interviews to find the real problem.

 Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

 Ownership. You own outcomes end to end and step in beyond your scope when the team needs it.

 Communication and structure. You align Marketing, design, engineering and leadership around evidence, and document learnings so the whole group can use them.

 3–5 years in product, growth or a related role in a digital B2C product, with a track record of running A/B tests

 Nice-to-have
 A marketing background, or experience working closely inside a marketing team

 Experience in a subscription business: trials, paywalls, pricing, churn and LTV dynamics

 Familiarity with tools such as Braze, Contentful, Google Analytics or Webflow

 Experience in a scale-up or PE-backed environment

 German language skills

 
 Benefits 
 Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:
 🏖️ 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off

 🏠 Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours

 🌍 Up to 4 weeks of work from abroad per year (Berlin-based roles)

 🏋️ Free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development

 📱 Free access to 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — our own digital wellbeing products

 🚲 €30 monthly mobility budget via Navit

 📚 €1,000 annual training budget + a wide range of opportunities for personal growth and development

 👨‍👩‍👧 Family-friendly benefits — childcare costs & paid sick days for children

 🍎 The office classics — fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks

 🐶 Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

 These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection. 
 
 People who make things happen
 7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Public APIs
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot , based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). 

 Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. 

 Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. 

 AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. 

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
 

 
 ⭐ Mission 

 Shape how Qonto connects to the rest of its customers' world by building the Public API strategy: a reliable, consistent API that powers integrations, partners, MCP and Qonto Embed, and turns connectivity into a growth engine for our all-in-one and upmarket ambitions. You will report to Fanny , who leads Qonto Connect, and you will own the product and governance framework that every Qonto team builds on.

 👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As Product Manager, Public API, you will: 

 
 Strategic ownership: Define the Public API strategy and roadmap for a product that already powers our integrations, MCP and Qonto Embed, and decide where to take it next.

 Meaningful, high-stakes impact: Make the API a reliable foundation for connectivity, helping Connect grow for our active customers.

 Platform thinking: Define a shared framework so that every Qonto team can build and expose its endpoints consistently, and partners can self-serve.

 Cross-functional leadership: Partner with PMs and engineering managers across Qonto to align on priorities and get API needs onto their roadmaps.

 
 🤔 What you can expect 

 
 Market context: The Public API is no longer just integrations. It now also powers MCP and Qonto Embed, so complexity grows fast and we need one person fully focused on its strategy.

 Team: You join the Connect team of 3 PMs (marketplace and bank aggregation, integrations, Public API), working with an engineering team that mixes backend and low-code engineers.

 The first question on your desk : what works well and what needs improvement in the Public API, how does each consumer of the API fit in, and what is our next bet in terms of use case tu enable and push via API.

 Tools: You work with the public API documentation (open to partners without a Qonto account), the developer portal, and AI tools. Being comfortable opening the docs or the code is part of the job.

 Rituals: a daily product and tech sync by scope, a Monday product weekly with peers, a Friday debrief to share wins and struggles, and a Monthly Connect showcase of results and new features.

 
 🏅 About you 

 
 Experience: You have solid product management experience and are comfortable owning a product that every other team contributes to, with a roadmap you have to build and defend yourself.

 API and technical sensitivity (a plus): You have worked on an API, integration, platform or developer-facing product, or you learn technical topics fast. You’re comfortable getting hands-on with API documentation and working closely with engineers.

 Stakeholder management and influence: You have aligned several teams around a shared product without hierarchical authority. You communicate clearly with PMs, engineers and senior stakeholders, and you consider the impact of your plan on every team before pushing it.

 Nice to have: Fintech, payments or partner-integration background, and curiosity for AI tools and vibe coding (we learn it together at Qonto).

jobs.title: Product Manager - Ecommerce Categories (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Product Manager - Categories (h/f/x)

Localisation : Paris, France

Domaine : E-Commerce Solutions — Navigate & Categories

À PROPOS DE DECATHLON & DU DOMAINE E-COMMERCE

Decathlon accélère sa transformation digitale avec pour mission de devenir la plateforme digitale du sport qui permet à nos clients de découvrir notre univers à travers des expériences locales, axées sur le sport et omnicanales.

Notre Mission : Faire bouger les gens à travers le sport pour rendre le bien-être accessible à tous.

En rejoignant ce périmètre, vous travaillerez au sein du domaine E-Commerce Solutions. Nos équipes transforment et déploient la navigation e-commerce mondiale, les arborescences de catalogue ainsi que les moteurs de catégorisation back-end visant à faciliter la découverte et l'accès à la totalité de l'offre Decathlon (produits, services et informations).

REJOIGNEZ LA SQUAD CATEGORIES

Rattaché(e) au Group Product Manager (E-Commerce / Navigate), vous prendrez la responsabilité de la squad Categories. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'une équipe d'ingénierie dédiée (Tech Lead, Senior Software Engineers) et en étroite collaboration avec les UX Researchers, Product Designers, Data Analysts, Sports Digital Merchandisers ainsi que les équipes E-Commerce locales des différents pays.

  • Vision Produit : Favoriser la découverte grâce à une navigation intelligente et évolutive. Nous construisons un parcours de navigation intuitif, automatisé et personnalisé pour permettre à chaque client de trouver plus rapidement ce dont il a besoin et ce qu'il désire.
  • Objectif Cible : Stimuler la conversion globale et générer du chiffre d'affaires incrémental en transformant des arborescences locales fragmentées en une Core Navigation unifiée et performante sur le web et le mobile.

VOS MISSIONS

Vision & Stratégie Produit

  • Définir la vision produit, la stratégie et la roadmap pour l'écosystème Categories & Core Navigation.
  • Piloter et arbitrer les chantiers clés du produit : Core Navigation (standardisation des arborescences au niveau mondial) et les Moteurs de catégorisation au niveau SKU (comme notre moteur de streaming Tesseract).
  • Aligner les parties prenantes (équipes sports centrales, merchandising digital global, équipes pays) autour de modèles opérationnels partagés.

Discovery & Gouvernance

  • Identifier en continu les opportunités utilisateurs, SEO et business via l'analyse de données, des tests utilisateurs et des études de card-sorting.
  • Etablir un processus continue et consistant d'AB test permettant d’affiner les convictions business et identifier les meilleurs opportunité de croissance
  • Concilier la standardisation globale avec la flexibilité nécessaire aux marchés locaux, en assurant la migration fluide des arborescences locales vers les Core Trees globaux.
  • Établir des cadres de décision et des SLA clairs pour la taxonomie globale, la gouvernance SEO et la création de catégories.

Delivery & Alignement Technique

  • Piloter le delivery agile en partenariat étroit avec le Tech Lead et les développeurs de la squad.
  • Prioriser et affiner le backlog (epics, user stories) pour soutenir les flux d'exportation multi-niveaux, les outils d'orchestration de batchs et l'exécution des règles taxonomiques.
  • Superviser les jalons clés de migration pour les pays adoptant le framework Core Navigation sur desktop et mobile.

Data & Performance

  • Définir et suivre les métriques de succès de la navigation, notamment le PDP Reach Rate, le Revenu par Session, le CTR d'utilisation du Menu et la Conversion par Catégorie.
  • Exploiter l'analyse de données pour optimiser la performance des catégories, éliminer les catégories inactives et rationaliser les filtres taxonomiques.
  • Agencer et prioriser le backlog en s’appuyant sur de la data claire et fiable 

Culture & Mindset Produit

  • Incarner un rôle d'ambassadeur de l'excellence produit et des standards de taxonomie au sein du réseau international de Decathlon.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif fondé sur la confiance, la responsabilité et la centricité utilisateur.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Expérience : 3 à 5+ ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager dans un environnement B2C

About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an  AI-first way of working . You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.

 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.

 Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
 Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
 AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
 Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.

 Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
 Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.

 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 
 Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.
 Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.
 Why this role? 
  
 As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

 
 What You Bring 
 You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

 
 It’d Be Awesome If You Also… 
 Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

 About Snyk 
 Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
